title: Chocolate Delight: Holiday Edition
seo_title: Chocolate Delight: Holiday Edition on Nov 25, 2026
description: Chocolate Delight: Holiday Edition is an hour-long activity where you make your own candy bars while sipping a drink of your choice. The summary describes the art of confectionary, with a white chocolate bar among the creations. It takes place Wednesday, November 25, 2026, from 1:00 PM to 2:00 PM at the Paint Studio in the Recreation Building.
